name: tera-exam-countdown-short
description: Tera vertical short: concrete exam countdown study plan.

scenes.title: Known pain
scenes.narration: Your exam is in seven days and your notes are a mess.

scenes.title: Unknown risk
scenes.narration: Trying to cover everything equally wastes the little time you have left.

scenes.title: Specific plan
scenes.narration: List the topics. Rate each one: confident, unsure, or blank. Spend most of your next study session on unsure and blank topics, then test yourself before moving on.

scenes.title: CTA
scenes.narration: Ask Tera for a focused seven-day plan built around the gaps that matter most.
